posts.content_md:
some one please explain what you would see in a simple holograpic grading 2 beam setup? would you get banding?

i did a 2 beam setup with my 405 making a simple grading and i get bands of light (rainbows) with in the ovals of interference of the 2 beams it was done in dcg. can it be improve with a narrow band pass filter?

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: No, there are no filters that are as fine as we are talking. A very narrow band filter is 1nm. A mica etalon can be made to .2 nm. My C315 is .0000045 nm!

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: I thought TE cooling would be a simple project but it turned into a year of at least 100 hours. If you go down the path listen to the people ahead of you. I had no guidence but wler's web site and a few others show how to do better than I did. That being said wler has not achieved a good red diode yet and I thought it would be a simple project for him with his experience.
